questions.q: Which chapter closed out Requirements 4 through 7 of the Lesson 1 Definition of Done (security model, Flows, validation rules, approval process)?
questions.explain: Chapter 3 (Lessons 11-14) implemented the security model, both Flows, all four validation rules, and the approval process.

questions.q: Which two fields does this lesson name as having been added mid-build rather than planned in the original Lesson 3 data model?
questions.explain: Primary_Contact__c (added in Lesson 13 for the Decision Maker validation rule) and Discount_Percent__c (added in Lesson 14 for the approval process) both emerged from Chapter 3 automation requirements, not the original Lesson 3 design.

questions.q: What does this lesson say is the real skill the capstone was built to practice?
options: Memorizing every Setup menu path in Salesforce
Translating a business situation into a declarative build, not just demonstrating individual features
Writing Apex trigger code as fast as possible
Passing the Salesforce Administrator certification exam directly
questions.explain: The lesson frames Cascade's specificity -- real people, real business reasons for each object and rule -- as what forced genuine translation skill, rather than feature-demonstration for its own sake.

questions.q: Why does the lesson treat documenting the two mid-build field additions honestly as more important than pretending the original design anticipated everything?
options: Because Salesforce technically prohibits adding fields after Chapter 2
Because a real data model evolving slightly as automation requirements surface is realistic, and honest documentation of that is more credible than a false claim of perfect foresight
Because those two fields will be removed in a future revision
Because interviewers never ask about data model changes
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly frames this as a lesson learned: real projects evolve, and an honest retrospective says so rather than hiding it.

questions.q: What is the next course in the Salesforce Administrator path after this capstone?
questions.explain: Salesforce Career Preparation is the path's final course, covering interview practice and mock technical interviews that build directly on this capstone's Lesson 19 walkthrough.
